page0.text:
"Anyway, Zouken had plans for Saber.
He wanted you to stay alive. But he had another reason to kill you.
...I'll ask again: he said that he didn't have any further use for you, right?"

page1.text:
...
I think back to last night's events.

page2.text:
"The Tohsaka girl is still worth using.
I have no further use for you, boy."

page3.text:
"...Yeah. He said you were still worth using, too."
"Okay... I don't know what he's up to, but that must be why he keeps running away from me.
Only one of us would walk away alive if we ran into each other, but Zouken's hiding from me because he wants me to live..."

page4.text:
Tohsaka considers it for a moment.
"..."
